newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady on Wednesday amid low demand from spinners and dealers said prices might fall further on Thursday on higher supply.
They said selective buying by spinners helped brake a fall, but reports that ginners have accumulated a stock of 1.964 million 375-lb bales might push rates down.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,250 rupees ($55.94) to 2,050 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
